candidates.title: Colorado Life Expectancy by Census Tract Published by NAPHSIS-USALEEP (2010-2015)
candidates.description: These data contain the Estimated Life Expectancy at Birth for residents of census tracts across the State of Colorado based on vital records data from 2010-2015.
